tools.name: clockify_invoices_import_time
tools.description: Import a client's billable time entries onto an invoice. Clockify imports every billable time entry in the from..to date range; narrow it with project_ids.

from.description: Start of the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339). All billable time on or after this is imported.

project_ids.description: Optional. Limit the import to these project IDs; omit to import all of the client's billable time in the range.

time_entry_group_type.description: How imported entries are grouped on the invoice: SINGLE_ITEM, GROUPED, or DETAILED (default). GROUPED also requires time_entry_primary_group_by.

time_entry_primary_group_by.description: Primary grouping dimension. Required when time_entry_group_type is GROUPED.

to.description: End of the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339).

tools.name: clockify_invoices_import_expenses

project_ids.description: Optional. Limit the import to these project IDs; omit to import all of the client's billable items in the range.

time_entry_group_type.description: How imported entries are grouped on the invoice: SINGLE_ITEM, GROUPED, or DETAILED (default). GROUPED also requires time_entry_primary_group_by.

time_entry_primary_group_by.description: Primary grouping dimension. Required when time_entry_group_type is GROUPED.

to.description: End of the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339).
